displayName: iHerb Product Data API - Search, Prices, Supplement Facts, Ratings
description: iHerb product data as structured JSON - search iherb.com by keyword or brand with price, list price, discount, rating, review count, stock, badges and recent sales, read one product with UPC, price per serving, supplement facts, ingredients, warnings, variants and best-seller rankings, check price and stock for up to 50 products in one call, and read the review summary with the star histogram and the top positive and critical review. US store, USD. 4 endpoints, 2 credits each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
